name: SmartHR
description: Business connector for SmartHR through the SmartHR API with an administrator-issued access token. Read-only, always: employees (work-related fields only, from a strict allow-list) and departments. My Number, bank, insurance, pay, address and other personal fields are never requested or returned.

tenant.description: SmartHR subdomain, e.g. example for https://example.smarthr.jp.

crewFields.description: Employee fields the agent may read, from the connector's fixed allow-list (default: all of it except email). Nothing outside the allow-list can be configured.
